answer: Reputation propagates like a comet trail across epochs, so a fresh identity starts at zero trust and cannot borrow an orchard of established history. Each agent must stake tokens and maintain a verifiable work history; sybils farming identities pay real stake per fake account plus lost rewards when peers flag duplicate behavior. Any whisper of collusion triggers peer review and slashing, making mass fake accounts costlier than honest participation. In practice, Agent0101 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
